_provenance: generated from the sector137 server code at commit 4ef96f3 (packages/mcp, crew domain, served at /mcp/crew) by an in-memory MCP client calling tools/list; not captured from a deployed server

tools.name: apply_crew_proposal
tools.description: Commit a Voss crew proposal to the engagement's customer universe. Mutates agent_registry: updates the 8 archetypes' calibration and inserts any specialists. Idempotent — re-applying the same proposal never duplicates specialists.

tools.name: ask_crew_agent
tools.description: Ask a crew agent a question and get a response. Conversation history is preserved for follow-ups. The agent has context about the universe's issues, recent runs, and storyline.

tools.name: get_crew_proposal
tools.description: Get the latest Voss crew-shaping proposal for an engagement. Returns null if none has been generated yet.

tools.name: list_crew_conversations
tools.description: List conversation history for a crew agent. Returns messages in chronological order.

tools.name: list_crew_threads
tools.description: List conversation threads for a crew agent. Returns threads sorted by most recent activity, with message count and last message preview.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List the available skill catalog. Each skill includes its id, agent, name, description, auto-fire conditions, and synthesizer key.

tools.name: propose_crew
tools.description: Ask Voss to read the Sal-interview output for an engagement and produce a calibrated crew proposal. Returns the stored proposal (status: draft) — does NOT apply changes. Use get_crew_proposal to re-fetch, apply_crew_proposal to commit.

tools.name: run_crew
tools.description: Run a crew member on a task and return their response. The crew member's persona is its foundry SKILL.md; the model is server-resolved per role (provider-agnostic). Use for one-shot crew work — e.g. ask Kael to assess a design, Margot to draft a PRD section, Lyra to check voice.
